g.text: LogicT fair search: interleave reaches a witness where unfair mplus diverges
mplus appends b's branches AFTER all of a's;
it descends the infinite left branch forever —
the witness in r₁ is never reached →
visit order a₁, b₁, a₂, b₂, … (round-robin) via the
VecDeque: msplit pops the front, suspended branches
are pushed to the back → bounded budget finds the
starved branch — never reached under mplus
found witness — finite, reached under fair search (blue)
the fair queue / Sat verdict (the VecDeque round-robin)
